title: Nutty Buttery Thai Pork Moo Ping
description: A buttery and flavorful Thai dish featuring pork, Szechuan peppercorns, and a crunchy deep-fry element, all in a convenient moo-ping form, cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat to 350 degrees.
In a large bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar.
Add the sliced pork to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Add the toasted and ground Szechuan peppercorns to the bowl and toss to combine.
Using a slotted spoon, add the pork to the hot oil and deep-fry until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In the same Dutch oven, add the melted butter and cook over medium heat until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the sliced shallots to the Dutch oven and cook until crispy, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped peanuts to the Dutch oven and cook for an additional minute.
Add the deep-fried pork back to the Dutch oven and toss to combine with the butter, shallots, and peanuts.
